info.name: SmartDairy - Procurement & Farmers API (Dairy Admin)
info.description:
Complete REST API Collection for the SmartDairy **Procurement & Farmers** module section using **Bearer Token (Laravel Sanctum)** authentication.

### Modules Included:
0. **Authentication (Bearer Token)** - Login, Admin Profile (`/me`), Logout
1. **Collection History** - List, Meta, Calculate Rate, Create, Show, Update, Delete
2. **Farmers Master** - List, Create, Show Profile, Passbook Statement, Update, Delete
3. **Rate Charts (Fat/SNF)** - List, Create, Show, Update, Assign to Farmers/Centers, Apply Historical Rate Correction, Delete
4. **Farmer Settlements** - List, Preview Period Calculation, Create/Settle, Show, Delete
5. **Advance & Loans** - List, Issue Advance, Show, Update, Receive Repayment, Farmer Advance Ledger, Delete
6. **Deductions** - List, Create Deduction/Credit, Show, Update, Farmer Deduction History, Delete
7. **Farmer Invoices** - List (Pending/Generated), Generate Period Invoices, Show Breakdown, Preview, Verify & Save Adjustments, Bulk Approve, Bulk Delete, Delete

item.name: 0. Authentication (Bearer Token)
item.description: Authenticate as Dairy Admin to obtain a Sanctum Bearer Token (`access_token`). Running **Login** automatically saves the token into `{{bearer_token}}`.
